gloss: business world; economic circles; financial community

definitions.gloss: business world; economic circles; financial community
definitions.explanation: The collective sphere of business leaders, corporations, and economic institutions, especially as they influence policy and public discourse.

examples.japanese: {経済界|けいざいかい}から{批判|ひはん}の{声|こえ}が{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: Criticism arose from the business community.

examples.japanese: {経済界|けいざいかい}のリーダーたちが{政策|せいさく}{提言|ていげん}を{行|おこな}った。
examples.english: Leaders of the business world made policy proposals.

examples.japanese: {新|しん}{首相|しゅしょう}の{政策|せいさく}に{対|たい}して、{経済界|けいざいかい}は{概|おおむ}ね{好意的|こういてき}な{反応|はんのう}を{示|しめ}した。
examples.english: The business community showed a generally favorable reaction to the new prime minister's policies.

notes:
Composed of {経済|けいざい} (economy) + {界|かい} (world, sphere). Frequently appears in news reporting about the relationship between business and government. In Japan, {経済界|けいざいかい} often refers specifically to the major business federations such as {経団連|けいだんれん} (Keidanren) and their influence on policy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {経済界|けいざいかい}の{重鎮|じゅうちん} — heavyweight of the business world
- {経済界|けいざいかい}の{反応|はんのう} — reaction from the business community
- {経済界|けいざいかい}と{政界|せいかい} — the business world and political world
- {経済界|けいざいかい}からの{要望|ようぼう} — demands from the business community

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {財界|ざいかい} — financial world, business circles; largely synonymous but slightly more emphasis on major corporate and financial leaders
- {実業界|じつぎょうかい} — industrial world; more focused on actual industry and manufacturing
- {政界|せいかい} — political world; the political counterpart to {経済界|けいざいかい}
